These tests were read, not rerun in this phase.

Namespace and concrete two-object key-order admission example: serializes reversed two-integer-field structs, compares bytes and three SHA computations and checked length equality. It establishes that fixture result only, not universal canonicalization or improvement correctness. Dependencies own encoding and DTOs; test runs that same sample. No automatic maintenance execution or authority promotion here.

Recursively sorts object keys, preserves array order/raw Unicode and restricts Number to i64/u64-representable integer values after serde_json::to_value. Generic Serialize input can lose type distinctions first: direct-source probe shows NaN and both infinities accepted as null with the same hash as None, despite documented float prohibition. Finite1.5 is refused. Parsed duplicate keys are already lost if supplied as Value; no input byte/depth limit. Tests cover nested order, Unicode, finite-float refusal and raw byte sensitivity, not nonfinite input. Encoding is its own integer JSON profile, not RFC8785/JCS.

Finding ID hashes detector version plus ordered path/content-hash/byte spans; candidate ID hashes ordered finding IDs and supplied baseline/replacement hash/path arrays. Body helper omits full bytes, authority, declared_write_surface and other policy fields by design. No validation of hash spelling, span grounding, equal vector lengths or actual bytes occurs. Span chain hashes fixed-width hex digests, avoiding concatenation ambiguity modulo hash assumptions. Tests cover order/version/path sensitivity; these are identifiers for declared material, not admission certificates.

Strict unknown-field DTOs contain no floating fields but public hash/schema/path/authority/always booleans remain unchecked. Defaults disable live provider and self-lane weight; terminal method always denies promotion. Span validator compares declared path/hash and end<=declared byte_len, not raw length/hash, so it requires a separately admitted source artifact. Base64 encoder is standard; exact decoder probe accepts misplaced/intermediate padding and nonzero padding bits (AA=A,AA==AAAA,AB==). Tests cover one raw-byte roundtrip and simple span bound, not malformed encoding or forged source metadata. Signed/frozen/independent labels and limits require host enforcement, absent here.

Private payload/phantom state enforces API progression through a caller-supplied FnOnce verifier to Verified then unconditional Admitted; no Deserialize or raw verified constructor. This proves only that the supplied callback returned Ok once, not its adequacy, purity or termination. Predicate macros perform actual runtime boolean checks with typed early errors, not static proof or rollback of prior effects. Tests cover simple positive/negative payloads and division by zero; test-only integer division still has MIN/-1 panic and its quotient postcondition is not valid for all signed inputs.

Declares closed category/role/capability/status vocabularies and a sealed BaseType validation interface. ContractEffect is explicitly contract-policy metadata with no conversion into runtime AuthorityEffect/CertifiedAuthority. Helper predicates partition the seven labels; capability policy is two public membership lists and permits contradictions unless external validators reject them. Tests exercise spelling strictness and membership, not component behavior. SchemaHash is unchecked 32-byte data; schema/witness names and mutability descriptors do not authenticate or enforce their semantic claims.

Reexports contract/audit/witness surfaces and generated audit summary. ThreeRoleCensus checks exactly three distinct nonempty strings, not allowed role identities, signatures, authority or independence. Positive and duplicate-role examples support only that lexical census.

Fixed ten-row ownership and three-row conversion ledgers identify intended MUB, arithmetic, functional, runtime and certification owners. It does not resolve modules/types, inspect conversions, ensure no contradictory additional conversion or execute MUB mathematics. Tests check fixed ledger consistency and physics-owner row. The ledger is architecture metadata, not evidence that exact/floating boundaries are enforced operationally.

NoAuthorityGuard reads a caller-implemented AuthorityTagged effect once and accepts only None. Tests accept diagnostic None and reject constructed Certified metadata. It cannot detect undeclared effects or bind later artifact behavior; batch tests cover two IDs and duplicate refusal.

Concrete three-form ASCII URN grammar with digit-only three-component version and leading-zero refusal; version magnitude intentionally unbounded textual. Test-only conformance adapter embeds a sibling fixture at compile time, validates schema/minimum28vectors/error-kind coverage, compares accepted parsed parts, refused error kinds, predicate agreement and accepted raw roundtrip against Python-owned recorded expectations. Tests offer bounded historical cross-language conformance, not independent grammar correctness or live Python execution. Public serializable normal-form identity/classification/envelope DTOs with aliases and many defaults; purpose is arbitrary JSON, hashes/statuses are unchecked strings, authority is caller supplied. Bounded32operator/64binding registry validates strict schemas, sorted unique lists, one exact witness-role set, None authority, no declared network/credential/hidden context, runtime/mode pairing, required capability inclusion and exact permission/write/evidence ceiling equality. Reads sorted recursive *.contract.yaml paths, records IO/parse/id/status issues as soft findings, and hard-flags unsupported textual authority levels or three exact artifact names. confers_no_authority means no recognized positive violation, even for parse failures, empty corpus or malformed/nonsequence allowed_artifacts; it is not complete proof of absence. Explicitly structural validation only, no mathematical theorem or runtime enforcement.

Concrete<=4MiB manifest/byte checks enforce portable relative YAML paths, device-name exclusions, casefold uniqueness, sorted entries, lowercase digests, recognized review-decision labels, all actual YAML accounted for, exact source SHA/identity/schema/projection byte parity. Closed document dispatch recognizes3schemas after typed YAML mapping/nonempty ID; non-v1 files are explicitly inventoried without validation credit. Strict top-level/machine descriptor DTOs project rich lifecycle labels into coarse status and assign explicit or math-default roles; unchecked direct projection falls back to MathObject for missing nonmath role. Validates exact schema tag, parsed Nomos URN, math None/nonruntime flags, nonmath role presence, known terminal/refusal strings and PO/SG/OB identifier grammar. RuntimeBudget is an immutable checked-u64 arithmetic model of limit/spent/remaining; spending zero and a zero limit are allowed. reading_receipts.detail: Runtime build gate; exact BigInt/Ratio plus JSON raw_value/arbitrary_precision, canonicalization and local kernel dependencies; explicit shared tests with autotests=false. Manifest does not establish parity or safe execution of host paths.

Contract-shape census parses applicable Rust runtime YAML, checks unique nonempty identifiers/types, supported nonempty struct/enum slots, checked totals and nonempty census, then invokes external shape enforcement. read_dir filter_map(entry.ok()) drops individual entry errors; downstream gate must be examined before attributing whole-build acceptance. Tests cover summed slots and unknown/empty/duplicate IDs, not unreadable entries or semantic behavior.

Exact JSON path encodes explicit typed tags, arbitrary integers as decimal strings, distinct list/tuple/set/frozenset categories, sorted mapping keys and framed SHA256. It is explicitly not JCS; domain length uses a checked-conversion panic beyond u32 rather than a typed error. Wire integer/fraction gates reject nonminimal integers and unreduced/nonpositive denominators, but compound decoder omits byte-hex validity, set/map uniqueness/order refusal, mapping-type restriction, dataclass field shape/uniqueness and nonempty enum identities. Native/Python comparison reproduced nine mismatches. Public variants allow encoding invalid fractions/FloatHex and malformed collections without validation. Recursion/sort allocation have no explicit fuel/bit/depth caps. Local tests exercise primitive golden bytes, map ordering, empty digest domain and float refusal, not malformed compound parity.

Constructs oriented graph incidence with correct self-loop cancellation and accumulates repeated face coefficients; dense storage preflight checks products/count limits. General public/deserializable complexes are revalidated through ExactCochainComplexQ at evaluation, then exact core_functional Gamma2 and primal/dual Phi1 determine exact, closed nonexact or nonclosed cases. Protected answers are equality checks on supplied maps; optional source custody verifies supplied bytes against supplied hashes but does not derive the graph from those bytes. Optional budget spends one evaluation allowance before dimension/chain checks, not arithmetic cost; no context permits an unbound carrier. Public deserializable CochainDisposition can carry unchecked labels when constructed outside evaluate. Graph face coefficients are accumulated before the external zero-denominator gate, a raw-rational boundary worth guarding. Tests exercise triangle dispositions/refusals, self/parallel edges, repeated/cancelled faces, overflow preflight, source mismatch and zero budget. No natural-language encoding adequacy or universal semantic preservation is established.

Full444lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Native task hash frames full immutable payload/task/path manifest; rolling chain binds submitted candidate ID, deterministic patch ID and patch SHA in order. Verification recomputes and compares caller-pinned expected task digest; evaluator additionally pins latest rolling digest. Explicit keyless-host limitation is accurate: callers controlling both expected roots and content can rebuild them. Mutable ancillary attempts/refusals/terminal/status/obstruction/receipt fields and producer identity are outside chain. Cardinality checks plus lookup do not independently prohibit repeated candidate IDs balanced by unused map keys, though normal submit prohibits duplicates. Provides no Git revision authenticity, patch execution, theorem proof or durable state. Meaningful lifecycle tests live in separate reviewed file.

Full485lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Create enforces scalar/path/list bounds and known nonempty gate subset; submit checks pinned root, unique candidate and count budget, records patch bytes even if diff invalid; evaluate pins latest root/patch hash and produces syntax/ownership/protected receipts. operation_budget is stored but never spent or used to cap patch operations; repeated evaluate is stateless and submit has no expected latest-root argument. Lexical path policy does not inspect filesystem; protected-vs-owned overlap at create is exact-string only. On syntax failure ownership/protection use caller patch.touched_paths, so consumer must honor syntax failure. Artifact schema/authority are not rechecked at evaluate, though bytes/digests are. No patch application, compiler/test execution or aggregate acceptance result. Capacity tests unrelated.

Full586lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Substantive finite tests exercise create-submit-evaluate positive lifecycle, protected path, two pinned Python path-manifest hashes, malformed scalar/path/budget/gate fields, repeated IDs, mutated payload, unadmitted/swapped patch and caller-held task/rolling-root mismatch. These are meaningful integrity regression tests, not proof against all parser/filesystem behaviors. Missing cases include malformed accepted hunk positions/binary metadata, replaying older root at submit, operation-budget accounting and platform path aliases. No execution rerun in this read; existing template capacity test separate.

Full102lines read. Pure text/control/bounded-ID and revision grammar checks, sorted-unique bounded path lists and positive bounded budget predicates. Path list delegates lexical security and separately rejects NUL; no filesystem containment/symlink resolution or revision lookup. Objective length is caller-unbounded when max_len=None. Local mutation test constructs literal Ok/Err and exercises no validation; it is not evidence of six killed mutants.

Builds one deterministic connected path-plus-chords graph for each positive target b1 and stores the chords as a reference; the seed argument is unused. Arithmetic and allocation have no resource ceiling and extreme target arithmetic can overflow. Public canonical digest sorts degree and weight multisets, providing relabelling invariance but not graph canonicalization: direct-source K3,3/prism counterexample shares digest despite different triangle counts (F024). Checker fixity compares two supplied strings without checking checker bytes or reference-answer computation. Local test merely fabricates Ok/Err tags, so claims of certified instances/self-play diversity or mutation adequacy are unsupported by this file.

Full341lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Carrier mask actually checks each supplied token's finite-set membership; logit-bias checks declared i32 magnitudes only; grammar branch checks64hex syntax without grammar bytes/digest recomputation/output parsing; NONE trivially passes. Receipt/case IDs and transport provenance are unchecked, so carrier_honored=true in nonmask branches does not witness runtime enforcement. F038 direct original-source probe shows i32::MIN.abs panics with overflow checks and becomes negative then passes without them. Existing tests cover normal mask/refusal and moderate/extreme positive bias, not minimum integer or grammar semantics. No decoder/model invocation.

Full571lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. State machine checks old/new header order, count consumption, no-newline marker placement, path set and several lexical traversal/device restrictions. It never parses numeric hunk start offsets, mode values or complete rename/binary syntax; binary path errors are silently ignored. A second plain header-only section inherits section_has_change from first. Original-module probes accepted nonnumeric hunk positions, unsafe binary metadata and header-only second section. Path predicate is lexical/case-sensitive, omits trailing spaces, NUL/control rejection and some platform device variants; caller needs filesystem containment/case policy before application. No source/base matching or actual patch application. Two real parser tests plus capacity template do not cover demonstrated counterexamples.

Full525lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. next_prompt checks policy list/string/token bounds and binds complete raw state plus normalized policy and prompt-body hash through framed canonical encoding; state collections/text themselves have no local bound, u64 diagnostic hints cast to lossy f64. step accepts any nonempty diff if caller-declared Phi1/Gamma2 are componentwise nonincreasing with one strict decrease. No patch parse/application/replay or metric recomputation occurs. Header's third defect-coordinate descent is not checked: new defect count equals declared Phi1+Gamma2 and may increase from independent old count. round_seq+1 and metric sum can overflow. DDC witness is summary text with no previous row hash; rejection emits no updated cemetery count. This is a declared-number transition scaffold, not verified scientific progress or operational code repair. Local tests only capacity template.

Dense Boolean exact arithmetic implements RREF with separate pivot-row advancement, rank, solve, kernel basis and chain-law-first gauge trichotomy with concrete syndrome, preimage or separating functional. Public matrices hide data and wire conversion uses new, but rows*cols is unchecked in new/zeros and allocations (F023). Direct-source probes reproduce constructor and JSON panic under checked overflow and malformed matrix acceptance otherwise without allocating large storage. Exhaustive matrices of dimensions0..3 pass5054 solve/rank/kernel cases and all 2x2 gauge boards/cochains pass1024 witness checks per build mode. Existing tests cover triangle cases, gauge invariance and ordinary dimension mismatches. Verdict enums remain public/deserializable declarations unless produced/rechecked against the board; finite algebra does not establish physical gauge interpretation.

Integral face-boundary closure accumulates arbitrary i64 coefficients with unchecked arithmetic; two minimum coefficients reproduce false closure under wraparound and panic under checked overflow (F029). Simplicial boundary reporting delegates construction, Euler characteristic and exact matrix compositions to core_homology; empty simplicial input is vacuously accepted and reports are public/deserializable. Ordered loop products check only common square shape, then use transpose for backward steps; inverse interpretation assumes orthogonal tables but orthogonality is not validated here. It multiplies current*step and compares exact entries with identity, not path composability or physical holonomy. There are no local mathematical behavior tests beyond the shared count/capacity template.

Renderer explicitly assumes admission-checked caller results. It validates one anchor/no closing marker, identifiers/digest syntax, at most128 input guidance items, configured item<=3/fence<=2048-byte bounds, unique IDs, nonempty guidance and admission-reference object, then selects in supplied order, records omissions and refuses missing required IDs. It hashes sorted-key request/rendering/binding data under a declared serde profile, not JCS. It does not authenticate admission references, review guidance, bind actual rule/catalog bytes, or prevent arbitrary prose in the reviewed-text field. Payload cloning/hashing precede resource gates, and guidance/metadata allocation has no local total-input ceiling. Only capacity tests are local; no prompt-provider calls were made.

Full348lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Bounded1MiB bytes-in dispatcher validates0/1 rows/cochain, delegates finite F2 classification and returns constructive lambda/separator/syndrome or board-chain-law witness. Mapping to suggested repair labels is policy description, not a proof those carrier changes solve the application. JSON first parses into Value, so duplicate keys collapse and unknown request/context fields are ignored; schema constants are advertised but request structs have no schema check. Detection accepts caller semantic_replay_passed/receipt and hashes whole request raw bytes while candidate is nested; trust/adequacy stays caller/checker dependent. Byte bound is not a matrix-work bound. Only capacity tests local; underlying F2 bounded probe already recorded separately.

Full582lines read. Implements UTF16-key sorting, finite-f64 shortest formatting, escape/surrogate handling and direct duplicate-detecting object parser, but raw parser accepts leading-zero01, trailing-dot1. and literal control newline in strings (probed vs serde_json rejection). Integer ceiling is bypassed if i128 parse fails; i64::MIN in Value path and i128::MIN in raw path use overflowing abs. Direct probe shows checked i64 panic/unchecked oversized rounded output, plus50-digit integer acceptance. Public serialize_jcs assumes pre-sorted duplicate-free JcsValue but API type admits unsorted duplicate keys and serializes them unchanged. No recursion/work bound or exhaustive ECMAScript rounding conformance; Value route cannot recover duplicate keys already collapsed. Local test is manufactured Ok/Err only; new probes are bounded implementation counterexamples.

Full587lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Hand scanner skips nested block/line comments and strings then searches boundary-delimited words; removing comments without whitespace can merge by and sorry into bysorry, hiding forbidden token. Raw strings, escaped identifiers and full Lean syntax are not modeled; no size/depth/work limits. Axiom parser accepts selected one-line text formats, ignores other output and overwrites repeated declarations. Audit trusts supplied build/harness booleans and finding list; empty required-declaration set/output can PASS, and duplicate later empty axiom line erases sorryAx in direct probe. This is not Lean compilation/kernel checking or binding to source/toolchain digest. Four semantic examples test ordinary scan/axiom cases only; no Lean process run here.

Full298lines read. Facade clearly distinguishes sorted no-float digest envelopes, typed tagged canonical wire and sorted plain request JSON, and delegates mathematics to adapters. Private LocalReplayBudgetWitness checks both axes positive and checked one-round subtraction; it neither consumes branch budget nor supplies global run termination. Exported authority/evidence functions are constant labels, not checks on every exported DTO. Build-generated contract shape/serde checks are field agreement only. Module blanket no-floating-point prose is narrower in reality: other exported prompt/JCS APIs use f64. Historical mutation count is not reproduced evidence.

Full181lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Thin CLI reads at most1MiB+1 and dispatches selected modes, writes one JSON newline and flushes, with encoding/output failures nonzero. Parse/input refusal deliberately exits0 as typed data; clients must inspect content. No provider, filesystem source scan or mathematical work beyond dispatch. Additional arguments ignored; no process timeout. Capacity tests are independent of I/O behavior; no CLI run.

Implements exact i128 Euclidean residue for positive modulus with documented panic outside that domain. The checked wrapper refuses nonpositive modulus and checks range plus reconstruction with checked subtraction/division/multiplication. Consequently it can conservatively refuse valid extreme negative inputs when lhs-residue underflows, even though rem_euclid has a value. CheckedResidue has no public value accessor in this module. Tests cover -17 mod5 and zero-modulus refusal/panic plus exactly reconstructed capacity boilerplate. No modular group law beyond this operation is checked.

Defines a public/deserializable planar coloured prompt syntax and inert kernel adapter; colours/arity are checked by constructors but direct construction can bypass them. Leaf bounds do not check UTF8 boundaries (F025) or digest/document identity. Conversion uses zero executor digest and delegates formal substitution, with incorrect slot indexing for expanding/nullary children (F027). Null absorption returns the child colour and bypasses graft boundaries (F028). Congruence ideals implement bounded i64 rational-text parsing, optional source comparison and a caller witness-validity boolean, not general congruence closure. Decoy refutation checks only the != substring (F026). Envelope validate checks schema, spans, arity and declared colours, not ID uniqueness, metadata authority, composition_tree, occurrences, source custody or ideal assertion semantics. Existing tests cover unary conversion, basic mismatch/ASCII spans, rational syntax and same-colour null absorption; probes expose omitted heterogeneous/non-unary/UTF8/false-refutation cases. No executed operadic law or scientific semantic adequacy follows from the architecture label.

Selection filters caller-declared Promoted status, actual prompt-text bytes<=1600, declared tokens<=400, exact byte-count equality and optional target colour, then takes at most3/1200 declared tokens. Promotion status/evidence hash/authority string are public unverified metadata; token estimate is not recomputed. Rendering independently accepts arbitrary operand references, and title/ID overhead is outside the size budget. The only local test fabricates Ok/Err tags and never calls selection, so the documented mutation-kill gate is not demonstrated here. This is bounded selection relative to declared estimates, not actual model-token or authority certification.

Full482lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Recursively validates tagged canonical tree shapes, minimal integer strings, positive reduced rational pairs, Python finite float.hex grammar, lowercase bytes, ordered unique sets/map keys and unique dataclass fields. Dataclass/enum module/type names are strings, not resolved types or mathematical values. No local recursion/total node/integer-bit bound; API can receive already-built deeply nested Value. sorted_json_bytes is plain serde JSON with recursively sorted keys, not JCS/typed-wire identity itself; floats remain subject to serde numeric spelling. Only raw U2028/U2029 separator regression and capacity tests local. Acceptance parity with Python requires broader tests than these syntactic invariants.

Full765lines read. Candidate closed DTO excludes selected host verdict fields; schema string/IDs and nested child-obligation discharged bool remain caller data. RoundRecord alone has private digest and no Deserialize; seal computes candidate digest and cannot accept chosen digest, but accepts all statuses/findings/successors from caller and leaves those public mutable. Digest binds candidate only, not round verdict or updated public metadata. Frontier successor clones parent/lineage and saturating-spends a round even when exhausted; type public mutability contradicts global immutable wording. TerminalProposal constructor derives conservative budget-based stop, but public fields/Deserialize bypass constructor and all_branches_inspected is trusted caller boolean. Tests genuinely cover positive candidate digest, forbidden fields, lineage and conservative stop; absence-of-Deserialize source scan is textual, not compile-fail proof. No replay procedure or comprehensive scheduler enforced here.

Full387lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Native finite string-answer profile produces Python-style sorted ASCII integer JSON, recursively strips bare expected and rejects listed hidden-label keys/fences; this is a lexical projection policy, not proof no answer leakage. Prepared binding is public mutable, so caller must retain trusted prepared object. check uses strict duplicate-rejecting JSON, exact four fields and task/attempt/input identity, then nonempty string; whitespace-only answer allowed by minLength1. replay rechecks exact binding/raw hash/extracted answer hash; evidence constructor itself accepts unrelated answer but replay detects mismatch. Checker ID binds recorded name only and invokes no task judge. No local total input/output bounds or provider calls; local capacity test only.

Full1066lines read: complete distinct source plus exact capacity template; truncated initial emission255–538 reread completely. Separate Python content-addressed profile checks closed field sets, lowercase SHA syntax, selected finite lists/identifiers/colours, normalized nested records and framed identity, optionally exact body hash/length. Compile returns normalized bytes; validation without body verifies self-consistency only. Dual witness is hash reference, not replay or mathematical evidence. Body1MiB limit is applied after byte-vector allocation; objective target arrays/render collections/regime bytes and render output have no local total bound. Reply validation remains label substring membership. Finite f64 hint conversion/rendering, Python whitespace/lowercase assumptions and shared canonical adapter delimit parity; no universal cross-language claim follows. Local tests only capacity template, external parity tests not rerun.

Full349lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Legacy profile normalizes body newlines and hashes body, sorts/deduplicates selected lists, sorts hints/demands without unique-ID validation, and accepts caller artifact/regime/parent IDs. Elimination receipt simply copies caller eliminated IDs/colours/evidence root. validate_reply_residual checks required substrings anywhere, not structured fields, values, actual residual or dual proof; any text naming every required label passes. Public mutable DTOs/Deserialize and unvalidated f64 magnitudes need caller admission. One positive/negative substring test plus capacity template; no model effectiveness or obstruction elimination evidence.

RationalMatrix checks rectangular shape, serializes exact canonical strings and validates wire entries via core_kernel parsing. Direct from_rows accepts Exact values without independently rejecting raw zero denominators; bounds/resources are not capped here, and public get uses indexing. Determinant clears denominators and delegates Bareiss, SPD delegates exact LDLT, rank delegates exact row reduction; characteristic polynomial implements rational Faddeev-LeVerrier. L1 certificate replay delegates core_functional exact primal/dual checking and keeps a private output-only certificate without Deserialize. Standard LP verifies nonnegative primal/dual vectors, inequalities, dimensions and exact objective equality; weak duality suffices for optimality although documentation invokes strong duality. Its public result fields do not themselves retain instance binding. Tests cover feasible/gapped/infeasible cases, quotient witnesses, exact wire negatives, and source-token checks, but not the newly inspected characteristic/SPD/rank methods or raw-denominator/resource extremes.

Public refusal DTO constructor trims/NFC-normalizes message only; direct fields/Deserialize can bypass that normalization. Private DiagnosticWeight certifies checked byte-length(code)+Unicode-scalar-count(message)+number-of-details <= positive budget, with nonblank whitespace-free code. Detail key/value sizes and locus do not contribute, so this is the declared metric, not a serialized byte/resource bound. Actual tests cover total18, small-budget refusal and spaced code.

Full260lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Intake SHA256-hashes provided raw bytes, sets expected=observed and all match flags true, and hashes ordered fixed-width content digests into source_manifest_root. This binds byte-content sequence but omits IDs/paths/bundle identity and assumes tracked=true without repository access. VerifyResearchClaimUseCase checks three caller-controlled booleans only, accepting empty bundles and inconsistent/missing observed hashes; no claim/proposition or source-content entailment is checked. Direct original-module probe reproduced equal roots across changed IDs/paths and verification of inconsistent receipt. One positive semantic test plus unrelated capacity test; no empirical research validation.

Declares finite Unicode-string rules/presentations and reexports reduction, peak and permutation owners. Documentation carefully separates pair joinability via closed reachable sets from global confluence/termination and producer testimony. Presentation fields are public; rule lookup selects first matching name, with duplicate refusal delegated to peak validation. The single-scalar permutation method computes a separate exact algebraic object; no pin or authority is automatic. Shared capacity template/tests are independent. Child semantics and all test files were fully read separately.

Meaningful tests cover Unicode scalar substitution, overlap/containment enumeration, missing obligations, framed JSON presentation hashing under reorder/field changes/delimiter attacks, host pins versus producer declarations, noncritical qualification, symmetric branch membership and provenance wire roundtrip. They compare bounded fixtures; the digest tests do not prove collision freedom, and a wire roundtrip does not authenticate the public evaluation. Passed within the58test direct-source run. Shared capacity code/test is exactly reconstructed and unrelated to rewriting laws.

Validates named rules/nonempty lhs, divergent replayable paths/endpoints and positive shared search budget; checks host presentation digest/pins and records noncritical-pair qualification. Complete BFS closures decide pair intersection/nonintersection, selecting minimum total distance then lexical tie; incomplete search stays bounded, and unpinned decisions surface SELF_CONSISTENT_ONLY. Public serializable evaluations are claims unless recomputed. Identical-endpoint shortcut incorrectly treats a different reachable declared common reduct as refuted (F030). Signature membership is not checked, budgets omit replay/enumeration costs, and no global confluence or Squier theorem is established. Direct probe reproduced the defect; existing owner tests otherwise pass.

Validates a nonempty finite single-Unicode-scalar signature, unique source rules, source/target membership, totality and surjectivity, then traces successor-oriented cycles from sorted least scalars and computes exact BigUint LCM via Euclidean gcd. Names do not enter the mathematical operation. Private witness has no Deserialize and holds computed order/cycles. Finite traversal termination follows from admitted bijection; no explicit memory/work bound beyond finite inputs. The only local test fabricates Result tags, not permutation behavior; no new universal correctness proof is claimed.

Implements exact scalar-indexed string substitution with no empty lhs, replay of named rule paths, overlap/containment critical-pair enumeration and BFS reachable closure. Reachability counts each viable redex position before probing, uses a single supplied u64 cap and reports a complete set only on empty frontier, retaining shortest distances. Length reduction is a sufficient termination utility, not a joinability gate. Enumeration and path replay lack fuel/length caps, while the probe budget does not bound string-copy cost or memory. Direct utility calls do not enforce presentation signature or unique names; peak validation handles name ambiguity. Meaningful associated tests passed under direct-source inclusion; shared capacity arithmetic is separate.

Fully read the fixtures and assertions for branch replay, honest/forged endpoints, bounded versus closed search, nontermination with finite closure, host versus producer cost, one combined budget, nearest join, testimony invariance, missing rules and structural obligations. Tests deliberately distinguish lookup/tag-only behavior from actual replay and preserve the pair-versus-system distinction. Some comments retain stale termination-witness language. The distant declared join regression only exercises unequal endpoints, missing F030; the u64MAX test closes a tiny search and does not reach the arithmetic limit. These tests ran as part of58passing direct-owner tests, not a full crate run. Shared capacity examples do not substantiate mutation-count comments.

Full826lines read. Exact rational set-cardinality/raw-l1 difference and delta/(1+cost) ranking avoid float thresholds; nonnegative cost ensures denominator positive for normalized valid rationals. cochain_delta is arbitrary keyed subtraction, not checked im(d0), and repaired IDs are declared; dual witness is merely Option<String> including empty string, never replayed. Thus is_exact_candidate is zero computed residual plus named witness, not quotient-repair certification. Optional kill-map ignores unrecognized triggers; constructor usage is self-report. Public scored DTOs can be inconsistent: rank_scored_candidates only repairs negative costs and sorts supplied efficiency, allowing illegal positive-cost rows with Some efficiency ahead of legal rows. mass_from_ids allows negative unit; illegal-path results skip magnitude validation. Tests cover exact tiny residuals, cancellation, strings, cost and ordinary ranking, not fabricated positive-cost scores/dual validity. Three f64 thirds sum exactly1 despite test comment; assertion itself only checks rational sum.

Full383lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Finite history recognizer flags repeated CUT for same declared state/move digest after prior stationary result, and repeated ASSERT of decided variable, resetting assert-count windows on declared descent. First trigger remains latched across later progress; CUT cache persists. Labels, digests, chronological ordering and uniqueness of turn IDs are trusted; no dynamics, mathematical stationary point or detector completeness is inferred. Recording every cumulative assert turns vector is quadratic output in repeated history; no local size bound. Tests cover nonadjacent repeat, single-assert negative and different-state negative only.

Candidate checker binds result ID/status, reruns the same native solver, compares exact energy/degeneracy and exact deterministic basis/decomposition rows, and requires the complete minimizer multiset. It separately verifies an OUT_OF_SCOPE witness actually names anticommuting terms; UNKNOWN must match the native refusal code. Phase/sign aliases must agree; rational energy comparison accepts equivalent unreduced positive-denominator pairs. This is genuine candidate-bound recomputation, but is not an algorithmically independent checker: shared solver defects could pass both. It accepts extra JSON fields, does not authenticate provenance, and the stated any-input totality is not formally established. Only shared capacity tests are in this file; no broader suite was rerun in this phase.

Admits object cases with1..8qubits and<=24terms; parses Pauli words through core_quantum_physics, checks length, creates fallback term IDs, rejects duplicate IDs, nonnegative i64 rational weights with positive denominator, and target±1. Supports aliases/defaults and tolerates unknown fields; simultaneous aliases are selected by precedence rather than checked for contradiction. u64 qubit count is cast to usize before the bound, so interpretation is architecture-dependent on32-bit targets. Pauli text is parsed before length admission. No commutativity is checked until solve. All local tests are shared capacity tests, not admission edge vectors.

Declares the bounded commuting-Pauli solver/checker API and public term/case/outcome DTOs, with maxima8qubits/24terms and deterministic input-order basis certificate contract. DTO construction/deserialization alone is not validation; exported solve/check parse JSON through the input owner. The mathematical claim concerns a finite Hamiltonian of supplied Pauli penalties, not empirical physics, a general noncommuting solver or benchmark success. Local tests only exercise shared capacity arithmetic. The advertised totality depends on input/parser/Pauli/arithmetic dependencies inspected separately; no universal panic-freedom proof is supplied here.

Parses the bounded input, rejects any anticommuting pair, extracts a deterministic GF2-independent generator basis, solves decomposition masks and reconstructs the full Pauli multiplication phase. Enumerates<=2^8 assignments of generator eigenvalues, accumulates nonnegative penalties with BigRational, and computes degeneracy as number of minimizers times2^(n-k). Unrepresentable final i64 energy limbs produce typed ENERGY_WIDTH_EXCEEDED rather than rounded/overflowed energy; empty terms give the full2^n zero-energy space. Correctness depends on isotropic Pauli independence, phase multiplication and equal rank-eigenspace dimensions; this is finite exact computation under those algebraic premises, not a formal proof or independent physical calibration. Internal checked-invariant helpers panic if dependency invariants fail. Only capacity tests occur locally.

Parses a byte-bounded JSON envelope (default4MiB, explicit caller override), rejects UTF8 BOM and recursively rejects decoded duplicate object keys before constructing serde_json Values. RawValue first validates syntax; exact-number retention depends on the enabled serde_json arbitrary-precision feature. The custom recursion has no separate depth/fuel argument and relies on library parsing behavior; source comment is not independent proof of stack safety. Local tests cover bound separation, duplicate key, private serde-number-key confusion and one integer beyond u64, plus exact capacity boilerplate. Parsing establishes representation validity, not domain semantics.

Full824lines read. For well-formed positive-weight graph and valid rationals, computes weighted l1 residual omega-Bsection and verifies dual B^Tz=0, |z|<=w, equality pairing=primal; these hypotheses establish finite rational optimum by weak duality. Cut admits nonincrease (including equality), Verify checks zero or dual, Retract restores prior snapshot and may increase defect; no universal descent/termination follows. Problem constructor checks shapes, vertices, unique directed edges and weights, but public struct/Deserialize plus try_new digest-only check bypass these predicates. Direct original-source probe admitted self-consistent negative weight with negative defect and mutated initial claims under original digest because process checks stored label without recomputation. Host/history/problem public mutability also defeats append-only invariant at API boundary; event digest omits details/snapshot/target property and links parent event ID rather than prior event hash. Public compute functions can panic on malformed shapes/raw rationals; no local budgets. MUB6 helper encodes supplied arithmetic in triangle, not MUB existence theorem. Local mutation test exercises no host behavior.

Full288lines reviewed through exact template reconstruction. Scheduler selects first Pending node whose dependency names occur among Frozen names, then marks Ready. No uniqueness, dependency existence or cycle validation makes DAG a label rather than proved acyclic graph. freeze_module directly sets first matching node Frozen with arbitrary code, without oracle receipt, status/dependency check or attempt increment, contrary to header invariant. Public nodes/status/authority and Deserialize bypass method expectations. Retraction renderer enforces Some previous_code and failing_diff for attempt>=2, permitting empty strings; no code execution or correctness check. Direct original-source probe freezes node with missing dependency and invalid code. Local tests only capacity template.

Full 283-line read. Two negative tests construct genuinely checked finite Phi1/Gamma2/trichotomy results then refuse ClosedResidual and ActiveClosureFailure into authority, including malformed guard deserialization. Dummy public metadata/hash/witness values do not authenticate an external carrier. Appended capacity-policy record is independent governance metadata, not a mathematical theorem. Tests source-reviewed, not executed in this audit.

Full 568-line read. Catalog tests count19packages/min40claims and check allowed status, ownership/module strings, explicit assumptions, None authority, lexical anti-hype rules, expected historical paper directories, raw Lean namespace/declaration presence, and lookup/witness labels. These do not resolve Rust proof types, run named harnesses, elaborate Lean, or establish scientific results. Historical atlas path is absent here. Header explicitly disclaims proof replay. Appended capacity record is governance data. Read only, no broad filesystem test run.

Full 330-line read. Actual 1x1 LP optimum/gap/infeasibility cases; Lean/effect metadata string assertions; AST source checks for named AuthorityEffect owners and conversions, with twelve mutation controls. Source guard uses obsolete code/crates_rs paths and recursively scans the code tree; not executed. No Meron checker or cancellation case occurs, so registry FSP harness links provide no Meron validation. Syntax inspection cannot resolve aliases/macros or prove all authority flows. Appended capacity-policy metadata does not strengthen mathematical evidence.

Full 275-line read. Seven finite exact form checks include weights1,1, representative3,-5, annihilator1,-1 and boundary1,1, yielding optimum8 versus competitor22, plus sign/polar/perpendicular/dimension refusals. Source-hash custody checks are conditional on historical Lean directory existence; current missing snapshot skips all three hash pins while metadata assertions continue. Not Lean compilation or axiom scan. Appended capacity-policy record is unrelated. Read only, not executed.
Frozen constructor/admission precedence vectors fail at danger receipt hash expectations. Two other tests pass. Fixture historical provenance not reconstructed.
Complete test source read. Missing input lifetime and end-of-block RefCell temporary prevent compilation; its intended 24-vector ordered-trace and injected-port-failure assertions did not run.

For n qubits and commuting Hermitian signed Paulis, an independent binary symplectic basis of rank k has 2^k joint eigenvalue characters, each of multiplicity 2^(n-k). Phase-correct decomposition expresses every term in that basis. Enumerating all characters gives the exact rational minimum of H=sum w(I-sP)/2 and its degeneracy. Separately, exact Gaussian-rational Schur elimination of H-EI establishes positive semidefiniteness and nullity. Those two finite implications justify the numerical minimum under the declared Hilbert-space representation. A sequence of exact local complementations on a labelled simple graph is a constructive orbit-membership witness. Cut rank over F2 is invariant under local complementation by elementary row/column transformations, so a subset with different cut ranks proves nonmembership. Equal cut ranks are not sufficient for membership. Exhaustive orbit closure proves nonmembership only when traversal truly exhausts the finite orbit. For invertible binary M, encoded occupation state is |Mn>. Majorana even/odd operators have fixed bit-flip column M e_j and parity characters derived from prefix rows of M^-1, with odd factor i. Signed-Pauli CAR and exact basis action establish the representation; expansion of fermion monomials then gives rational Pauli Hamiltonian coefficients. For N11/12 the actual1024samples have augmented GF2 ranks12/13. Since signed-Pauli phase ratios on binary linear encodings are affine characters, these full ranks exclude every nontrivial affine phase mismatch; this closes this specific finite Majorana check under admitted representation premises. For nonnegative weighted graph-incidence Hz with one endpoint column for boundary edges or two for interior edges, correction syndrome is an odd-degree boundary condition. Shortest-path perfect matching of defects (with appropriate boundary copies) computes a minimum T-join; path overlaps can be removed modulo2 without increasing cost. A genuinely feasible matching dual attaining the correction weight would certify optimality. The advertised internal-odd-set dual is not such a dual: for primal x(E(S))<=(|S|-1)/2, plus-sign z in edge constraints/objective must be nonpositive. Positive z requires a different cut formulation. Read all implementation bodies and entrypoints in this helper; generator/solver agreement alone is not a soundness argument. Full C029 family analysis and limits: AC2130-C029.

For indices occurring once or twice, contracting live disjoint tensor groups costs product of union dimensions and leaves symmetric-difference indices. For N>=2 final-step cost is at least the product P of all open-leg dimensions, so P>B or final size P>S proves infeasibility. reading_receipts.detail: Defines 12 finite/arithmetic/table/refutation examples; generation runs solver+dual and accepts warranted refusal separately. Writes original example/answer paths, so not run. Claimed range split examples are ordinary small Nat statements.

Calls reference solver and exact checker in-process, writes every answer even failures, then calls all answers verified in terminal message. Not U09 sandbox or independent replay; not run because it overwrites historical answers.
Validates alphabet membership and stores supplied scores; no strict descent, zero gamma2, or mathematical correctness enforcement. Trace string alone does not prove kernel execution.

Raw regex ban scan including comments, PATH-selected Lean, timeout subprocess, separate Submission.olean/Judge.lean with copied target and axiom print. Shared wrapper has no OS sandbox, no version equality or binary hash, no parsed command-list whitelist. Native controls distinguish these limits from kernel proof validity.
Wraps fixed tactic portfolio with C,I,D,E,T or M traces. D/E scores are assigned from final status, not a measured per-tactic strict descent history. No provider call here.

Exploratory prompt-method runner, full reply custody and separate outcomes; no actual attention/logit hooks. M5 omits prelude; CLI imports a matrix module absent from this frozen/current directory. Network-capable code was read only and never executed; external infrastructure remains a dependency.

Aggregates retained scalar counts and known costs, corrected to avoid fixed findings. Tier naming uses model substrings, no parameter authentication; totals trust input records, no independent proof or billing validation.

Seven fixed proof and three refutation scripts; retries infrastructure failures once, distinguishes repeated timeouts, then abstains. No range-split implementation despite header. Single-file solver check differs from two-stage judge; DDC closure is owner check only.
Import-path setup only, no math checks; searches provider directory but performs no provider calls.
Positive small Fin proof and rejection of sorry/native_decide/illicit aux/wrong nonempty ID. Does not test absent IDs, pin equality, or multi-command aux blocks.
Checks 4.34.1 text, budget config, twelve examples and syntactically parsed answer fields; does not compile retained proofs or authenticate receipts.
Stub-based regression tests for retry/timeout/infra distinctions; meaningful control-flow evidence, explicitly no Lean process and no theorem proof.

Native tests for printed axiom spoof, sorryAx, escape tokens, namespace target shadowing, refusal scoring and missing Lean. Uses any PATH toolchain and skip by executable presence, not version; covers known bypass classes only.
Small rfl/propext compilation, banned tokens and syntax diagnostics; does not cover parsed command enforcement or toolchain pin.
Three native portfolio controls: finite addition proof, false finite shift refutation, malformed prelude refusal. No completeness or large-case proof-search evidence.

Planned SAT/problem versus UNSAT/canonical-CNF proof semantics, admitted generator equivalence. drat-trim/LRAT/Rust/native sandbox claims exceed actual pure-Python single-checker dispatcher; bounds and large-instance targets not exercised by small retained cases.

Full configuration/accounting body read. Declared ceilings ofUSD0.25/0.50/1.00 and preferred targets are historical settings, not evidence of paid cost, tokens or elapsed time. Empty runs/calls and zeros are not zero-cost successful experiments. The prospective whole-run USD0.10 limit remains separate.

reading_receipts.detail: Computes normalized CNF hash, prioritizes supplied cnf_text, runs shared DRAT engine and flags empty/unit refutations. Strict per-line triviality parser disagrees with permissive DRAT DIMACS parser; no raw-CNF correspondence or header enforcement.

Dispatches one problem checker for SAT or one Python DRAT engine for UNSAT; no dual consensus. Missing/wrong IDs ignored. OOS succeeds only when encoding raises, rejecting some malformed-but-encodable cases and accepting fabricated witness text.
Single wrapper of shared family_solvers.check_problem_solution; strict solution integer discipline comes from owner; no independent second implementation.

Constructs small40 base16gauge8poison and48mutants, writes examples/results without validation. Gauge first16cases changes mostly edge order; no polarity/variable transformations. Regeneration would restore expected_kind into public examples and omit triviality marks. Original generation not executed.

Read reference/public replay and pass counter. Every True verdict, including unsupported UNKNOWN/OOS, is counted as passed; aggregate pass is not solved-isomorphism coverage. No provider run.

Read permutation and matrix closure, Cayley normalization, identity/inverse/associativity validation and generator discovery. Exact group test on wellformed tables; no strict bounded integer entries, primality/dimension/degree check. Supplied generator indices are trusted and redundant lists retained. Composite p4 matrix example accepted as C2, outside promised prime field domain.
Read allowed DDC alphabet and string event summary. Operator-name assertion is trace structure only, not a mathematical descent certificate or verification of narrated searches.

Read finite element orders, center, commutator closure, conjugacy classes, quotient and p-power counts for abelianization. Sound finite invariants conditional on a valid normalized group table. Float logarithms used for small integer prime powers. Independent finite checks reproduce catalog group axioms, order, center and histogram, not a second proof of every invariant routine.

Read image assignment search, generated-subgroup pruning, bound and homomorphism extension. Product verification is sufficient for bijective homomorphism when complete images map valid indices. zip ignores extra images. Search excludes already generated images even for redundant input generators, so identity/repeated generators can wrongly exhaust; bounded search cannot justify nonisomorphism.

Read identify filtering and compare separator/search flow. Isomorphism certificate is independently checkable, but catalog identity is a trusted name. On search failure compare emits NOT_ISOMORPHIC with conjugacy-class values already known equal, and trace says exhaustive despite cap. Duplicate-generator C2 selfcomparison reproduces false negative rejected by primary checker. UNKNOWN is accepted elsewhere and can mask incomplete identification.
Read path insertion only; changes module visibility, no mathematical evidence.

reading_receipts.detail: Exactly evaluates a nonzero point or a Hilbert obstruction after a primality gate. The point equation is direct. Its Miller–Rabin helper has a claimed 64-bit domain but is used on unrestricted places. OUT_OF_SCOPE recomputes malformed input but ignores witness content. Missing case fields can raise KeyError, and noncanonical decimal strings pass.

Read all 64 static forms and labels plus top-level writes. Many solvable rows are constructed with (1,1,1). The proposed obstructed form (1,2,-3) also has this point. The form (1,1,-7) claimed obstructed only at 2 is also obstructed at 7. Planned difficult semiprime coverage is absent. Generator source was not executed; retained data labels are separately assessed.

Read 48 attacks on coordinates, small composite places, false places and OUT_OF_SCOPE claims. These are useful baseline controls but omit large-prime cost and the above-64-bit pseudoprime case. The generator was not executed.

reading_receipts.detail: Separately implements Jacobi recursion, Hilbert symbols and exact trial division. Both Hilbert implementations agree with 108 primitive modular conic controls. OUT_OF_SCOPE checks malformed coefficients but not the supplied witness. Trial division is exact if it finishes, but a bounded two-second probe on 2^61-1 was stopped without a verdict. Coordinates must be strings; Boolean values are rejected.

Read the point equation, all-place Hilbert criterion and output schema. Hilbert equivalence requires nonzero coefficients; zero cases are handled directly. TASK bound 10^18 differs from CHALLENGE bound 10^30. Canonical decimal syntax is not enforced beyond integer parsing.

Full configuration/accounting body read. Declared ceilings ofUSD0.25/0.50/1.00 and preferred targets are historical settings, not evidence of paid cost, tokens or elapsed time. Empty runs/calls and zeros are not zero-cost successful experiments. The prospective whole-run USD0.10 limit remains separate.

reading_receipts.detail: Read 12 examples with expected outputs derived from the owner solver. Top-level writes use a legacy demos path. The purported large solvable example is (3,5,-8); expected labels do not come from an independent PARI replay. The generator was not executed.

Checks status/kind and directly evaluates positive points. Negative answers require only a nonempty place, without primality or Hilbert-symbol validation. Passing the public runner therefore does not certify obstruction answers; this audit invokes the actual checkers separately.
Re-exports solve only; no additional proof or checker is introduced.

Read 12-base Miller–Rabin, Pollard rho and the factor stack/fallback. No per-case factorization budget exists; the rho loop is uncapped. An unfactored remainder is inserted as prime after a limited trial fallback. The explicit composite 399165290221 * 798330580441 passes above 64 bits; this is not deterministic arbitrary-precision primality.

Read valuations, odd-prime Euler criterion, 2-adic epsilon/omega factors and the real sign formula. The formulas require nonzero arguments and a prime place; the helper itself does not establish primality. All 108 independent primitive modular conic controls agree. Finite controls do not prove Hasse–Minkowski.

Read zero-coefficient/opposite-pair fast paths, sign permutations and bounded z search. No Legendre descent or squarefree/coprime reduction is implemented. A z cap of 50000 and coordinate caps of 2000 skip both loops for x²+y²-2001²z², despite the immediate point (2001,0,1). The Holzer label does not justify completeness after practical clamps.

Routes malformed input, real obstruction, bounded point search, Hilbert place 2, and factor-based prime scans before UNKNOWN. It correctly avoids turning failed point search into a negative theorem. FACTORING_LIMIT also labels point-search failure after successful factorization; no operational timer enforces that code. The trace is fixed stage metadata.

Read valid-point, malformed-input, zero/Boolean/float-coordinate, and composite-9 rejection tests. They meaningfully exercise a prior refuse-all repair and intentionally accept bare OUT_OF_SCOPE on malformed input. They omit large-prime bounds/cost and the coordinate-cap counterexample.

The stated finite category theorem is universal factorization with unique mediators, and adjunction requires natural unit/counit plus both triangles. These are conditional on actual categories, diagrams and functors. Bounds and complete tables are specifications, not enforced facts. Existence recomputation does not certify the submitted apex or legs; the advertised independent validator is weaker.

reading_receipts.detail: Checks case ID and recomputes existence using the same owner routines. EXISTS checks only object/morphism membership, not leg typing, commutation or universal factorization. ADJOINT checks one triangle after separately establishing some adjunction; it omits submitted naturality and the second triangle. NOT_ADJOINT and OUT_OF_SCOPE ignore the supplied witness content. Validity inherits the category normalizer and omits functor laws.

Read all 948 lines. Constructs 40 base, 16 controls and 8 poisons and writes on import, so not executed. Base35 and base40 reversed-order maps are not functors, although labelled non-adjoint; eight gauge adjunctions differ only case IDs. Comments on base28 mappings differ from actual valid Galois maps. Poison 64 comment mentions identity preservation but data actually lacks a composite. Examples are curated declarations, not independent ground truth.

Creates 48 mutations in six limited classes and writes on import. Despite docstring, no validator is invoked to establish rejection. Fake names exercise membership but miss wrong existing apex, valid-named wrong legs, nonnatural adjunction components and repeated objects. Root test already xfails the secondary mutation check.

reading_receipts.detail: Creates twelve public cases and derives expected answers directly from owner solve; not independent truth. Includes a nontrivial monoid no-product case but no existing repeated-object product. Writes legacy demos path, so not executed during source-preserving audit.

Compares statuses/kinds and sometimes exact apex or OOS reason against owner-generated expected data; it does not validate universal legs, mediator uniqueness, naturality or triangles. Exits nonzero on aggregate mismatch, but passing this runner is an example regression only.
Exports the solve function only; no second implementation or validation is introduced by the package interface.

Builds hom sets and normalizes composition by overriding identity entries and filling unique hom sets. Identity detection depends on id-prefixed names or first endomorphism. Explicit contradictory identity entries are erased before validation, and typed closure, duplicate labels and unknown endpoints are incompletely checked. Associativity enumeration is meaningful only after these input assumptions.

Computes colimits by category duality and adjunction by hom-cardinality screen plus enumeration of natural transformations and triangle identities. Conditional on valid functors, this is finite exhaustive search. Functor laws are never checked, and unknown colimit shapes return absence. Shared dependence on limits and category normalization prevents independent validation.

Exhausts cones and unique mediators for terminal, product, equalizer and pullback constructions under valid input assumptions. Product legs keyed by object names collapse repeated objects: an independently built 15-arrow category has A x A = P but returns no product. Diagram shape, parallelism and typing are not separately enforced. All 342 meet/join comparisons on 19 three-object posets agree.

Routes finite tasks after normalized category validation; returns witnesses or absence using shared routines. Does not validate diagram or functor laws or enforce stated object/morphism ceilings. Unsupported colimit shape becomes DOES_NOT_EXIST; LIMIT unknown becomes UNKNOWN. Trace is a fixed list of stage letters, not measured descent.

Equational proof by contextual axiom instances is sound only when substitutions bind variables, not ground constants; a countermodel needs total closed operations and universal axiom satisfaction. The planned Rust/Python dual checker, lemma chains, 200-step capability, 36 base plus12 controls plus8 poisons, and provider/prover comparisons are not established by delivered Python implementations or retained examples.

reading_receipts.detail: Reimplements substitution and positions but shares the constant-substitution flaw; negative positions can modify operator symbols and non-lr directions act as reverse. Countermodel branch tests only goal inequality and ignores every axiom, table closure/shape, constants, bool types and missing operations. Thus independent authorship does not establish an independent semantic gate.

Explicitly distinguishes variable strings x,y,z from ground constants a,b,e and promises universal axiom evaluation for models. Implementations substitute every atomic string and incompletely validate model domains. Position syntax is nonnegative argument indexing; secondary negative-index behavior violates it. Output examples and contract do not prove runtime soundness.

Full configuration/accounting body read. Declared ceilings ofUSD0.25/0.50/1.00 and preferred targets are historical settings, not evidence of paid cost, tokens or elapsed time. Empty runs/calls and zeros are not zero-cost successful experiments. The prospective whole-run USD0.10 limit remains separate.

reading_receipts.detail: Defines12 bare input examples and writes them on import; contrary to planned worked chains, includes no output proof chains or long group consequences and replaces UNKNOWN with reflexivity. Nonassociative magma example is not a nonassociative loop. Data labels are not independent mathematical certification.

Counts any SOLVED or OUT_OF_SCOPE response as a pass without calling a checker or comparing expected truth. An empty example directory passes0/0. Public runner success therefore supplies no certificate soundness evidence.
Exports owner solve only; no external prover, Rust replayer or independent validation is added.

Primary enumerates all lexical axiom-variable assignments and requires goal inequality; constants must be present and in range. It coerces bool/string/float entries to ints and never checks operation dimensions or closure. Thus f(0)=1 in a claimed singleton domain passes. Finder only searches sizes2..3 and unary/binary operations, eagerly materializes tables, ignores signature consistency and cannot certify absence of larger models.

Bidirectional breadth-first exploration stores complete paths, reverses backward step directions and splices at identical JSON terms; bounded at depth/node ceilings and returns None on search exhaustion. Extra variables on replacement sides remain lexical variables rather than enumerated ground instances, limiting completeness. On nine unary axiom pairs and nine ground goals, 47 emitted proofs replay independently and have no two-element countermodels. This does not establish general completeness or long-chain capability.

Validates equation envelopes only, searches proof depth 5/nodes2000 then models through size 3, and returns budget-coded UNKNOWN if neither found. The budget code is a search ceiling, not provider accounting. Trace CRIET is fixed stage metadata without obstruction values. It does not replay a produced proof before emitting or implement lemma storage/conversion.

Matcher recognizes a fixed lexical variable convention and preserves constants, but apply_subst and rewrite_step replace every string named in a supplied map, without checking variable membership. Position navigation in the primary correctly rejects negative/out-of-bounds children. Terms lack recursive grammar and signature checks. This is matching rather than general unification.

Documents test commands and an expected 36-pass count plus a14-example scoring command; these are instructions/expectations, not executed evidence or independent LP correctness. No wiki page contents are inherited.

Implementation owner and its declared input/output boundaries. Flow feasibility plus equal-capacity cut witness; arithmetic verification independent of how the candidate flow was found. Full body coverage transfers from the completed imported body read and complete canonical diff review. Arithmetic owner copies are exact matches. Integration differences are imports, root sentinels and output paths, with no additional max-flow verification rule. The matrix remains a shared synthesis_matrix adapter over ten inline public cases.
Re-exports solve only and does not validate or certify results.

Dinic residual representation keeps distinct forward/reverse edges for parallel and antiparallel arcs and adjusts reverse indices for self-loops. BFS levels, DFS blocking flow and final residual reachability produce a flow/cut pair. Independent minimum-cut enumeration agrees on 1241 complete small networks. Recursive DFS crashes on a1100-node unit chain. Fixed push bound10^32 is safe for declared capacities<=10^18, but loses scale-independent runtime on unrestricted larger capacities; no runtime failure beyond the contract is claimed.

Attempts case.get before dictionary validation, so null input raises AttributeError. Casts nodes/endpoints/capacities with int, silently truncating floats and admitting Booleans. Both previously reviewed judges share arc coercion, accepting a rounded replacement instance. Does not enforce TASK capacity10^18 ceiling or guard recursive solver exceptions.

All 271 lines read. Thompson construction, epsilon closure and reachable subset construction preserve language; partition refinement yields reachable quotient states. All 146 lines read. Uses explicit dot insertion and shunting yard despite recursive-descent description. Dot is permitted as alphabet literal but collides with inserted concatenation and causes valid dot concatenation rejection. Whitespace is stripped/skipped even when declared a literal. No alphabet size ceiling; duplicate and reserved operator checks otherwise explicit.

All 97 lines read. Validates alphabet element shape and regex strings, catches parser errors, but not compilation/resource errors; case.get precedes object validation. No alphabet or syntax-node bound. Reference can falsely reject dot literals while both judges correctly reject that refusal.

All 169 lines read. Strong regressions for historical source-binding, missing automata and long distinguishing word defects; scans all packet cases/mutations and rejects trivial responders. Parser fuzz uses 4,000 seeded strings over fixed a,b grammar, excluding dot/whitespace alphabet cases. Import-independence check is textual and not proof of independent authorship. Executed read-only with bytecode/cache disabled: 12 passed.

Expected-value comparison gates. Isolated actual function probes reproduce unchecked metadata fields, boolean/integer alias acceptance and answer-bearing failure strings. Distinct entrypoints have different strictness; the 18-field gate is not an exact typed/schema validator.
semantic_full_text

Read imports/default paths, import-time spec expansion, expected certificate construction and entire appended rule/work-unit miner. Synthetic probes establish arity/signature mismatch, unrelated node-route pairing, hash arithmetic independent of statement and default PROVED_LEAN. Most original per-node mining code remains unread.
semantic_full_text

Explicitly requests JSON extraction and prints precomputed certificate values; not a blind derivation task. Coupled compiler calls a dictionary-typed expected_certificate field as a function, reproduced without importing legacy dependencies.

Read benchmark implementation: generates 1000 units and checks each against its own expected ground truth. It does not call a model. Other live/ablation/reporting runner code remains unread in this phase.
semantic_full_text

Tests require sibling-repository prompt/evidence layout, inspect historical ablation summaries, and feed generated expected answers to the benchmark gate. Not executed: default paths and import-time external reads are outside this probe scope.
